newsitem.title: USA: Meadow Valley restates 1996 to loss.
newsitem.headline: Meadow Valley restates 1996 to loss.

text.p: Heavy construction contractor Meadow Valley Corp said Wednesday it had restated its 1996 earnings to a loss of $0.02 a share from a profit of $0.17.
The company, which released its 1996 earnings on February 18, said it was forced to adjust the figures after reviewing its field costs.
"While management does not anticipate further adjustments to the 1996 results, there can be no such assurance," it said.
The company originally reported a 1996 profit of $0.17 a share, down from $0.65 for 1995.
Based in Phoenix, Meadow Valley specializes in structural concrete construction of highway bridges and overpasses, and the paving of highways and airport runways.
